question: Who may still suffer burning despite contact with the tip of nectar and essence?
premises: The tip of nectar is mentioned
The essence of juice is present
Even a wise person may be burning
inference: Even a wise person can experience burning despite proximity to nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are not explicit.
plain_english: Even a wise person may burn, though at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
